context: Grading a validation script and project config that safely onboard a new default GitHub Copilot model.

checklist.name: api_query_in_validation_script
checklist.description: validate-model.sh fetches models from the GitHub Copilot API (via fetch-models.sh or direct curl), not from `opencode models` or a hardcoded list.

checklist.name: policy_state_check
checklist.description: Script verifies the target model has policy.state == 'enabled' before proceeding.

checklist.name: auth_from_correct_path
checklist.description: Script reads the auth token from ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json.

checklist.name: exits_on_unavailable_model
checklist.description: Script exits with a non-zero code or clear error message if the model is not found or not enabled.

checklist.name: per_command_test_step
checklist.description: A per-command test (e.g. `opencode run --model ... 'test prompt'`) is included before setting the project default.

checklist.name: opencode_json_default_model
checklist.description: opencode.json contains a "defaultModel" key set to the target model ID.
